question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom:

**Won his laurels**
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'** i.e. '**Achieved distinction or fame**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Won his laurels"** means to gain honor, recognition, or fame through achievement. (यश या सम्मान प्राप्त करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The young scientist won his laurels after discovering a new vaccine.
 
 
 
• **"Achieved distinction or fame"** refers to earning respect and recognition due to success or excellence. (प्रतिष्ठा या प्रसिद्धि प्राप्त करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She achieved distinction or fame through her outstanding performance in the competition.
 
 
 
• Thus, **'won his laurels'** clearly indicates gaining fame or honor through merit.

Therefore, the correct answer is- Achieved distinction or fame.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings:

 
• **Lost everything** (सब कुछ खो देना): To lose all possessions, status, or success.
 
• **Changed his opinion** (अपना विचार बदलना): To alter one's viewpoint or belief.
 
• **Saved money** (पैसा बचाना): To keep money instead of spending it.
